text: Fixed. The issue was in `textkit/slug.py`: the regex `[^a-z0-9]` replaced each non-alphanumeric character individually with a hyphen, so consecutive punctuation/whitespace produced multiple hyphens, and leading/trailing characters produced edge hyphens. I changed the pattern to `[^a-z0-9]+` (collapse runs into a single hyphen) and added `.strip("-")` to remove leading/trailing hyphens. The public signature is unchanged, tests pass, and both reported cases now return the expected output (`"hello-world"` and `"a-b"`).
